name: Prasanna
text:
Fwd: Bike rack
Three racks were removed for welding. Prasanna flagged the missing bolts. Reinstall is booked for Friday afternoon.

name: Veksler
text:
Forwarded from Security Desk
Subject: Door access
A temporary badge was issued for the loading bay while the reader is replaced. Veksler will collect the old one once the audit finishes. Until then, visitors must sign in at reception.

name: Quinto Gippner Sliz
text:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Procurement
Subject: Sample approvals
Two suppliers sent updated fabric samples, and both arrived creased. Quinto Gippner Sliz compared them against the approved swatch and recommends rejecting the heavier weave. A third sample is due before the order closes next month. Please reply with your preference.

name: Campara Colthof
text:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Finance
Subject: Petty cash
Campara Colthof signed off the receipts from the site visit. The tin needs another float before Friday.

name: Ezatollah
text:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Site Office
Subject: Generator service
The weekly generator check was skipped twice. Ezatollah ran the full test this morning and found the oil level low. The service crew has been asked to come Wednesday instead of next month.

name: Krylov
text:
Fwd: Incident follow-up (from Compliance)
The visitor log for last week has gaps on two afternoons, and nobody can explain them. Krylov reviewed the camera timestamps and matched both gaps to a badge reader fault. A written note is now required at the desk whenever the system drops out. Training starts Monday.

name: Roswitta Senoussi
text:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Lab Desk
Subject: Freezer alarm
Roswitta Senoussi heard the alarm reset itself overnight, so the log may be wrong. Please check the panel history.

name: Davey Inverneiro
text:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Events
Subject: Marquee deposit
The marquee company wants half the fee before they confirm the date. Davey Inverneiro checked the budget line and says we can cover it this quarter. Approval is needed by Thursday or the slot goes.

name: Raeto
text:
Ward Clerk — forwarded notes
Three discharge summaries went out with the wrong follow-up dates, and the clinic has started calling us. Raeto checked the template and found an old calendar embedded in the footer. A corrected version was sent before noon, and the affected patients were called. A review of last month's batch is underway.

name: Lee
text:
Fwd: Lost umbrella
A grey umbrella was left in the lobby on Tuesday. Lee thinks it belongs to the courier who signs for parcels.

name: Keip Persiaux
text:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Training
Subject: First aid renewal
Two certificates expire at the end of the month, and the refresher course is nearly full. Keip Persiaux reserved the last two places this morning. Payment must clear before the course provider confirms the booking.

name: Radmanovic Kuckelsberg Ssemuwemba
text:
Audit Desk: forwarding the stock count queries
Four lines in the quarterly count still have no owner, and the deadline is Friday. Radmanovic Kuckelsberg Ssemuwemba traced two of them to a moved aisle and will recheck the labels tomorrow. The remaining pair sits with the night team, who were emailed late yesterday. Answers are expected before the audit meeting.

name: Castorina
text:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Housing Office
Subject: Key return
Keys came back without tags, so Castorina will relabel the cupboard on Monday and set aside the spares.

name: Nodar
text:
Community hall meeting, 12 March
Present: six residents, two staff
Item one: the boiler survey quote came in at four thousand. Nodar asked whether the repair could wait until autumn, and the room agreed to get a second quote.

name: Schorling
text:
Minutes, roof committee
Present: estates, two contractors
The membrane survey found three soft spots above the stairwell. Schorling advised a full strip rather than patch repairs, quoting similar costs over ten years. The committee asked for a phased plan and agreed to revisit the budget in April. No decision until then.

name: Hivin Vallet Cambera
text:
Toolbox talk, bay four, morning shift
Seven fitters attended.
Hivin Vallet Cambera raised the cable ramp that keeps slipping near the spray booth. A new mat is ordered.

name: Sabija Sinthu
text:
Tenant forum, 7 February
Nine people came.
Parking dominated again: two vans block the turning circle every evening. Sabija Sinthu suggested numbered bays and offered to draft a map. The idea was accepted in principle, and a copy will go up in the lobby.

name: Thinesh
text:
Safety committee, 21 March
Present: warden, two technicians, one visitor
The warden reported that the loosened handrail by the north gate was repaired on Tuesday. Thinesh suggested a monthly walk-through and volunteered for the first inspection. The group also discussed better lighting near the bike shelter, though no budget was assigned. Next meeting is in May.

name: Dunkelberg
text:
Budget review, second quarter
Five cost lines were cut.
Dunkelberg questioned the training figure, which doubled without explanation. Finance will reply by email before the next round.

name: Tan Renée
text:
Ward handover, night shift
One isolation room occupied, two discharges pending.
Tan Renée flagged that two call bells in the east corridor are slow to answer and asked for the electrician to be called today. The linen order arrived short again.

name: Antonenko Hepberger Bajda
text:
Programme meeting, week 12
Six tasks open, two overdue.
The warehouse shelving order is delayed by customs, which pushes the fit-out to May. Antonenko Hepberger Bajda proposed splitting the delivery so the east bay can open on time. The client agreed to review the revised dates and will confirm by Friday. Costs stay inside the contingency.

name: Divja
text: Staff briefing this morning: both fryers are down. Divja raised the missing thermometer in the walk-in and asked for a replacement before the weekend rush. The order list was updated.

name: Niethammer
text:
Library committee, 4 April
Eight members present.
The quiet room booking system keeps double-booking study desks at weekends. Niethammer from IT explained the sync delay and promised a patch by the end of the month. Members agreed to report clashes through the form until then.

name: Durs Solyana
text:
Joint estates meeting, 9 May
Present: both landlords, one surveyor
The shared drain camera survey found tree roots at the boundary, and neither side wants to pay first. Durs Solyana offered to split the excavation cost if the work happens before July. Both parties accepted, and a contractor will quote next week. The minutes were circulated the same evening.

name: Cugura Mahfar Pilan
text: Gate review cancelled today; only two of five leads joined. Cugura Mahfar Pilan moved the decision to Thursday and asked each lead to send written notes first.

name: Stehmann
text:
Parking working group, 18 June
Four spaces remain unallocated.
The bays behind the workshop flood whenever the drain blocks, so they stay empty. Stehmann proposed raising them with a gravel platform and will price the job. The group agreed to decide after the summer.

name: Kamar
text:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Front Desk
Subject: Parcel room overflow
Three pallets of brochures arrived early and are blocking the walkway to the loading bay. We stacked what we could in the cage, but the rest is still on the floor. A second drop comes tomorrow morning. If nobody claims them by noon, they go to storage. Kamar

name: Essabbai
text: The lift maintenance report is below. Nothing urgent, but the door sensor is drifting and will be replaced at the next visit. Any access changes should reach Essabbai before Friday.

name: El Euchi
text:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Payroll
Subject: Timesheet corrections
Two overtime claims were entered against the wrong cost code, which delayed the run. The sheets were resent and the difference is small. Please confirm the fix landed, and thank El Euchi for catching it.

name: Orijana Inoué
text:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Facilities
Subject: Kitchen deep clean
The extractor hoods are booked for stripping on the 29th, which means the main kitchen closes at two. Cold prep can continue in the annex if the fridges are moved first. Catering has been told and will post signs on the doors. Any concerns should reach Orijana Inoué.

name: Fedor
text:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Stores
Subject: Gloves
The medium nitrile gloves are down to the last box. Keep the spare carton for the night crew and ask Fedor.

name: Karaman
text:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: IT Support
Subject: Printer queue
The label printer on the mezzanine keeps dropping from the network after about an hour and jobs vanish from the queue. The driver update is scheduled for Thursday evening and Karaman will test it Friday.

name: Mescuso Verest
text:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Dispatch
Subject: Van allocation
The blue van is going in for its service on Tuesday, which leaves two vehicles for four routes. The early runs take priority, so the late routes will share the hire car. Bookings for Wednesday should move to Thursday. Any conflicts go to Mescuso Verest, who is covering dispatch this week.

name: Crisanta Sholpan
text:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Lab
Subject: Incubator log
The incubator log has a gap from Sunday. Samples in tray four may be affected. Hold them and tell Crisanta Sholpan.

name: Ilmira
text:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Scheduling
Subject: Room swaps
The training room is double-booked on Thursday, and the smaller group has a guest speaker coming. I have moved the induction session to the annex. Please update signage and let Ilmira handle the visitor passes.

name: Jungmichel
text:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Accounts
Subject: Refund backlog
The refund queue grew this week because the card terminal rejects partial reversals after five. Two batches were reprocessed manually, and the rest are waiting on the vendor patch. Until that lands, all partial refunds must be split into full reversals and fresh charges. Escalate anything unusual to Jungmichel.

name: de Lillo
text:
---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Reception
Subject: Visitor badge
The new visitor badges arrived without clips, so they cannot be worn. de Lillo will bring clips from the supply room.

name: Serafin Rzic Picamilho
text:
Fwd: Slip near bay two
An oil patch by bay two caused a near miss during the shift change. The absorbent granules were empty again. Signage goes up today, and Serafin Rzic Picamilho is tracking the fix.

name: Ivica
text:
Rota planning, 14 March
Six gaps remain for the holiday weeks, mostly on the weekend shifts. The rota board is up to date, but two slots are penciled in without confirmation. Agency cover is being priced as a fallback, and the draft will be shared tomorrow. Any swaps must be requested in writing from now on. Ivica

name: Leko
text:
Stores review, 2 April
Four small tools are missing from the shelves. The cage lock is being replaced next week, and the missing items were reordered today by Leko.

name: Bajrush Hedayat
text:
Housekeeping huddle, 11 May
Two floors are short of linen again, so the laundry is running a second evening cycle. The contractor will deliver on Wednesday. Rooms on the third floor take priority this week. Bring any shortages to Bajrush Hedayat.

name: Gian-Paul Rover Masciarelli
text:
Production review, week 15
Three lines ran under target, and the packaging order is two days late. Maintenance blamed a sensor fault on line two, which was cleaned on Friday. The schedule for next week has been rebuilt around the late delivery. Overtime is approved for Thursday only. Any further delays should be reported to Gian-Paul Rover Masciarelli.

name: Djurdjija
text:
Ward round notes, Friday
Three discharges are planned before noon. One bed will stay free for the emergency intake tonight. Discharge letters are stacked at the desk for Djurdjija.

name: Corliano
text:
Complaints review, 27 April
Five cases closed this week, two escalated to the landlord. The recurring theme is noise after eleven from the same courtyard. Extra patrols were agreed for a fortnight. Case notes are due by Wednesday, and Corliano will prepare the summary.

name: El Ghoudi
text:
Contract review, 3 June
Two clauses need legal sign-off, and the insurance schedule is missing a certificate. The supplier has agreed to extend the deadline by a week, which keeps the start date intact. Site access will be arranged once the paperwork clears. The signed copy must reach the project office by Friday. Track it through El Ghoudi.

name: Vaz Pires
text: Handover note to the weekend team: the boiler pressure is holding and the east gate sticks. Nothing else needs attention. Questions go to Vaz Pires.

name: Eithan
text:
Waste audit, 8 July
Three bins were contaminated again, mostly cardboard in the food waste. The signage near the loading bay is faded. New labels have been ordered, and a short briefing will be added to Friday's toolbox talk. Direct any queries to Eithan.

name: Pirrera
text:
Interview panel, 19 September
Four candidates were shortlisted, and the schedule is tight because two panels overlap on Friday. The competency questions have been finalised, and the scoring sheet is in the shared folder. Room bookings are confirmed for both mornings. References will be requested after the offers are approved. Send any panel updates to Pirrera.

name: Nureddin Abdulai Cestaro
text:
Shift handover, east site
Two deliveries are booked for the morning, and the crane inspection is outstanding. The keys are with the desk. Report incidents to Nureddin Abdulai Cestaro.

name: Tiuri Minchev
text:
Quarterly review, 30 September
The team met its delivery targets, though two handovers slipped into October. Training hours are ahead of plan. The only open risk is the spare-parts lead time, which procurement is chasing. Next review is in January. Filed by Tiuri Minchev.
